setup.name: system
setup.command: curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_26.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs --no-install-recommends && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

setup.name: postgres
setup.command: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y postgresql && sudo service postgresql start && sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE USER calc WITH PASSWORD 'calc';" && sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE calculator OWNER calc;"
